matching_validation.note: Aggregate metrics only. This is not independent test-set accuracy and not an ML model metric.

active_ask_to_historical_concordance.limitation: Retrospective same-snapshot concordance, not an independent out-of-sample validation of active-only outcomes.

active_only_validation.reason: Items classified active-only have no accepted realized sold evidence in this snapshot.

pricing_evaluation.evidence_path: AUTO_CONFIRMED and HIGH_CONFIDENCE classifications; unique active listing identity

parameters.ask_to_sold_0_79: implemented parameter; retrospectively benchmarked, not independently validated
parameters.demand_weight_0_05: implemented initial business parameter; explicitly not backtested
parameters.scarcity_weight_0_10: implemented parameter; no reproducible independent calibration artifact found
parameters.trend_weight_1_0: implemented scaling parameter and business rule

pricing_evaluation.percentage_metric_note: Median APE is secondary because very low-price parts make percentage error unstable; MAE and median absolute error are primary.

stale_state.calculation_scope: Current pricing joins accepted evidence to current staging_inventory and the final contract is rebuilt from current eligible staging rows, so these stale rows are excluded from current dashboard calculations.
stale_state.cause: Inventory row identities changed across ingestion/cleaning snapshots while append-only decision and summary records retained older inventory_uid values.
stale_state.recommended_private_fix: Add snapshot or upload_batch scoping to operational decision/summary tables and retire stale summaries during a controlled maintenance migration; do not blindly delete historical decisions.
